text:
devon: Hey team — new customer onboarding requires GPU quota increases and capacity reservation in Azure. Target SKUs: ND40rs_v2 (A100 80GB) and NC24rs_v3 (V100). Regions: eastus2 and westeurope. Subs to update: sub-prod-1 (subId: 72a1f3d2-aaaa-4bcd-8888-111122223333), sub-dedicated-2 (subId: b3c2e1f4-bbbb-4cde-9999-222233334444), sub-staging (subId: c4d3f2a5-cccc-4def-aaaa-333344445555). Can someone open support requests (quota + capacity reservation) and link to a Dedicated capacity request if needed?

priya: +1 on priority — onboarding date is next Tue. We should request both quota increases and a capacity reservation (reservation ID request) to avoid cold-start shortage.

mike: I'll open the support tickets. Quick checklist: subscription owner on CC, expected peak nodes (prod: 12 ND40rs_v2, 8 NC24rs_v3), and fallback SKUs (NDv4) documented. Any cost approvals needed?

devon: Prod 12/8 numbers look right. Cost team signed off on provisional spend but include estimated monthly commit: ~$85k/mo for dedicated pool. CC: olga and infra-oncall. Also ask Azure to confirm NSG/vNet port limits for our node pools — last time we hit 65k ephemeral port warning in west europe.

mike: Opening tickets now. Using portal link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Quota/QuotaApprovalBlade. I'll paste ticket IDs here when created. Command I ran for usage check: `az vm list-usage --location eastus2 --output table` (runs returned CPU cores and GPU SKUs showing zero available for ND40rs_v2).

azsupport-bot: Support request created: 2201123456. Title: "Quota increase + capacity reservation request — ND40rs_v2, NC24rs_v3 for sub-prod-1/sub-dedicated-2/sub-staging". Assigned to Azure GPU quota team.

mike: Ticket 2201123456 created for sub-prod-1. For sub-dedicated-2 and sub-staging I made 2201123457 and 2201123458. Adding notes: expected start 2026-03-31, backup region francecentral if eastus2 unavailable.

olga: Thanks — can you add the CV of the workload (batch inference, steady throughput) and the expected per-node sustained tokens/sec? That helps them size backend capacity. Also request port limits checked.

mike: Added workload notes and perf numbers. I also requested quota for Network Interface (in/out) and ephemeral port range extension: "Please confirm that vNet/NSG rules will support 64k+ ephemeral connections per node or advise mitigation."

infra-oncall: Heads-up: if Azure cannot guarantee ND40rs_v2 capacity we want automatic fallback to NDv4 with lower batch sizes. Add fallback routing policy to the ticket and to the playbook.

devon: Good call. Also asked support to provide estimated lead time for reservation fulfillment and whether reservation will be region-locked.

azsupport-bot: Update: Azure quota team responded — initial review requested subscription validation. They asked for billing contact and tenant ID for sub-prod-1. Please provide ASAP.

priya: Posting tenant/ billing contact in DM. Also note that westeurope has a partial allocation; we should prioritize eastus2 for prod.

mike: Logged tenant ID for sub-prod-1 in the ticket and added billing contact. Follow-up ETA from Azure: 48–72 hours for quota decision, 5–10 business days for capacity reservation confirmation (subject to availability). Keeping this thread updated. :thumbsup:

devon: Great. Once tickets are approved, schedule a capacity smoke test and a canary rollout for the model. Thanks everyone.

mike: Will do. I'll update with final ticket threads and the reservation ID when we get it.

(azsupport-bot): Ticket notes: 2201123456 — "Azure action required: region capacity check -> accepted for review"

olga: tagging cost for tracking: @olga please confirm cost center code when ticket moves to reservation stage.

priya: noted. I'll coordinate with cost ops.

mike: last_message: updating ticket 2201123456 with requested backup plan and canary timing — end here for now, will follow up when Azure confirms capacity.
